node.title: Aligned common-pencil three-petal LS6 atoms are empty
node.statement: For a rate-half M=4,t=3 LS6 atom with defect a>=1, nonemptiness forces deg(Etilde)>=a: otherwise deg(D Etilde)<2ell, so the unreduced product has degree greater than the allowed remainder cutoff ell-a. If the three touched locators are L_i=P-z_i and their source labels are affine in z_i, normalization makes Etilde=(z_2-z_1)^(-1) constant. Hence every such aligned common-pencil atom is empty. Misaligned pencils and arbitrary locators are not claimed.
